caption: The drawing depicts two ornate metal objects, which appear to be bits for horse bridles, suspended from short chain links at the top and bottom. The bit on the left is silvery gray and decorated with detailed, symmetrical, circular and floral engravings, and features smooth, curved lines. The bit on the right is a darker, rusty brown with a rougher, pitted texture and less ornamentation, though it includes two narrow, reddish-brown straps or pieces wrapped around part of its structure. Both pieces have rounded edges and a hooked component near their center. The objects are shown in a vertical orientation on a plain, light beige background with no additional elements, and the artist’s signature “Arthur E. Reynolds” is visible near the lower right corner.
title: Bit
